column1: # The source paths are the already verified, Google factory-derived files in
# firmware-manifest.tsv.  The destination names are requested by the
# candidate kernel's upstream brcmfmac4383 and btbcm drivers.  This is copy/rename only;
# it is not a format conversion or a compatibility claim.  This mapping is
# used only by the radio-first rootfs workflow; the canonical Google bcmdhd
# route keeps its original names and is never silently renamed. The
# factory-selected Bluetooth `brcm/BCM.hcd` already matches btbcm's runtime
# name and is therefore carried by the canonical manifest without an alias row.
